dimensions.accepted_intent_and_scope: Pass: preserves read-only issue context and ordinary issue access; excludes command, journal, scheduler, and production scope. #49 remains dependency context, not a review target.
dimensions.source_and_lifecycle_contract: Pass: adopts Lighthouse source evidence and shared lifecycle without a policy fork; separates lifecycle result from workflow status and requires exact result/run/revision/attempt association rather than recency.
dimensions.bounds_and_artifact_safety: Pass: hard conversation page, record, text, request, and response limits stop further fetches at caps and expose bounded partial coverage; artifact byte/member/type limits and bounded streaming/rejection behavior are specified.
dimensions.authority_and_isolation: Pass: gates reads on configured repository and effective user authority; isolates issue cache and removes prior data on authority/account loss while retaining stale data only for transient failures.
dimensions.evidence_and_presentation: Pass: missing, expired, inaccessible, malformed, spoofed, unsupported, and incomplete evidence remains explicit; specifies safe Markdown and keyboard/phone accessibility.
dimensions.readiness_and_later_gates: Pass: readiness and owner authorization are recorded; actual connected-user/source consent and final current-head CI remain later gates, not claimed complete. Existing #49 and separate production boundary are respected.
dimensions.shared_lifecycle: Pass: follows the adopted shared lifecycle, Done dimensions, and integration gate; does not introduce SoFa-specific lifecycle policy.
